import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r-dr, c-dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run=[]; rr,cc=r,c
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color:
                    run.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                if len(run)<2: continue
                for sr,sc,vr,vc in ((r-dr,c-dc,-dr,-dc),(rr,cc,dr,dc)):
                    while 0<=sr<h and 0<=sc<w and grid[sr][sc]==bg:
                        out[sr][sc]=color; sr+=vr; sc+=vc
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
ns={}; exec(code,ns); out=ns['transform'](grid); print(out)
